visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy long dark hair and a dark navy shirt stands in a brightly lit kitchen. He holds a stainless steel pot with dark brown, sticky caramel residue. In a visual overlay, a larger pot of dark caramel is shown. He uses a wooden ladle to lift the thick, dripping syrup, looking directly at the camera with a questioning expression. The background features a clean kitchen with a blue shelf and green plants. (2) The scene cuts to the man holding a white and blue carton of milk, pouring the liquid into the small pot which is now sitting on a black portable gas stove. The white milk splashes into the dark brown caramel. He holds the pot handle with his left hand and the carton with his right. (3) A close-up shot shows the milk and caramel mixture bubbling and foaming inside the pot as it heats up. The color of the liquid turns to a light brown latte shade. A hand enters the frame and drops two tea bags into the hot, steaming liquid. The wooden ladle is used to stir the mixture gently. (4) The man pours the steaming caramel milk tea into a large metal mixing bowl. Steam rises visibly from the liquid. He then holds up the empty pot and ladle to show that the caramel has been completely dissolved and the pot is clean. He smiles broadly at the camera, wearing a silver necklace and a dark button-down shirt.
